title: Technical Content Writer
description:
**Tell us where you fit the best,** **we will tell you how to get there…**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------

We being an employee\-centric company, offers you a fun\-filled environment to excel in all the tasks you perform. Our endeavors aim to improve your learning curve so that you can gain a significant amount of life\-changing knowledge as you work with TOPS. We are looking for the skillful, hardworking and talented individuals who wish to cultivate cross\-functional abilities. If you think, you have strong fundamental values and forward thinking approach to stand apart from the crowd – we are here to help you!!!
  
### **Technical Content Writer**

Experience: 3\+ Years \| No of Openings: 2

  

Job Description


* Write service and landing pages, long\-form blogs, and case studies built on research and internal project demos not surface\-level summaries
* Attend walkthroughs and demos of delivered projects, ask the right questions, and turn what you see into a clear story of problem, approach, and outcome
* Own on\-page SEO for what you write: keyword research, structure, internal linking, meta descriptions
* Hand off publish\-ready drafts to the \[web/marketing] team, and flag existing pages that need refreshing
* Write campaign copy alongside the marketing team email, ads, gated assets
* Present drafts to the marketing team and, for major pieces, to founders; revise on feedback
* Keep voice and positioning consistent across everything we publish
Key Responsibilities


* 3\+ years writing for a technology company, software services firm, or B2B tech agency
* A portfolio of 3–5 published pieces you wrote start to finish, ideally including one case study or technical explainer
* Ability to sit through a project demo, follow what's happening, and ask the questions that produce a usable story
* Working knowledge of SEO fundamentals and at least one research tool (\[Ahrefs / SEMrush / Search Console])
* Strong written English clean structure, no filler, minimal editing needed on a second draft
